baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two bounded believer factions and the twice-repeated repair of what is between them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two distinguishable portions can separate while their between remains both an interval and a tie; repeated reconciliation therefore works on the damaged relation rather than erasing either party.

activation_trace.role: The bounded group or portion makes each faction a real part without making it the whole community.
Settled security and trust supply the common ground damaged by fighting among believers.
The interval between two things supplies the spatial object into which mediation acts.
The standing connection between parties keeps the interval relational rather than empty.
Removal of mutual aversion gives the repair commands their social operation.

changed_reading.before: Two believer groups fight and a third party should settle their dispute.
changed_reading.after: Conflict has pulled apart bounded portions within one trust-community; intervention repairs the middle and its tie while preserving the parties as distinguishable parts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from mutual fighting, through one-sided overstepping and directed fighting, to return and renewed reconciliation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Initially reciprocal combat is reclassified when one side oversteps; corrective force is then selective, lasts only until return, and hands the process back to reconciliation rather than becoming a new permanent relation.

activation_trace.role: Mutual combat supplies the symmetric opening condition before responsibility is differentiated.
Crossing the limit into oppression identifies the asymmetry that changes the intervention.
Subduing until hard force softens supplies a corrective, endpoint-bound function alongside literal combat.
Turning back supplies both the stated terminus of force and the transition into renewed repair.
The binding directive provides a supra-party destination for return rather than surrender to the rival.

changed_reading.before: The verse licenses defeating the aggressor.
changed_reading.after: It authorizes a selective interruption whose warrant expires at return to a norm above both parties; force is subordinate to restoration, not victory.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second reconciliation is newly qualified by justice and the command to act equitably.
baseline_models.mechanism: Return stops the coercive phase but does not complete repair: justice straightens and balances, while equity measures and assigns shares, so the settlement must correct burdens rather than merely stop blows.

activation_trace.role: Return opens a post-conflict phase rather than itself exhausting reconciliation.
A load balancing another load makes justice a redistribution of unequal burdens.
Straightening supplies correction of a settlement that might otherwise remain bent.
Allotted share and division make equity concretely distributive rather than merely well-intentioned.
The straight balance supplies an inspectable measure for the repaired arrangement.

changed_reading.before: Once aggression ceases, restore peace fairly.
changed_reading.after: Cessation triggers a second task: straighten the relation and rebalance burdens and shares so peace does not preserve the prior asymmetry.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The shift from a command to act equitably to a named class of equitable actors whom God loves.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ending turns one equitable decision into a repeatable identity; the seed branch of love permits an exploratory cultivation model in which just settlements reproduce a durable disposition rather than close one case.

activation_trace.role: Justice and equity link the commanded act to the named equitable agents at the close.
Clinging attachment makes divine love an enduring orientation toward equitable actors.
The carried seed-grain supplies the exploratory image of each just settlement propagating future equity.

changed_reading.before: Equity is a procedural instruction for this dispute.
changed_reading.after: Equity is also a cultivated actor-type: a just settlement can seed the stable communal habit named and loved at the close.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening prohibition on advancing in the presence of God and the messenger revises corrective fighting into delegated action: interveners may enforce return to God's directive but may not turn their own timing or preference into the directive.

activation_trace.role: Forward precedence makes acting ahead of authority the prohibited motion.
Presence before the hands locates communal action under, not ahead of, God and messenger.
The binding directive is the target of return and limits the intervener's independent authority.

structural_cues: 49:1 places non-advancement before God and messenger before 49:9's order to make the aggressor return to God's command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibited precedence and a divine directive; I infer that coercive authority is derivative and non-preemptive. A live alternative is that 49:1 regulates general etiquette without specifying conflict procedure.

changed_reading.before: A third party may determine and impose the proper outcome once aggression appears.
changed_reading.after: The third party acts as a constrained executor of a prior norm, not as a sovereign that may get ahead of that norm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Raised voice and lowered voice provide an escalation-control pair, while unnoticed collapse of deeds warns that damage can accumulate below awareness; the subduing function of corrective fighting therefore gains a pre-coercive analogue in reducing social amplification.

activation_trace.role: Raising supplies the upward amplification that can turn difference into dominance display.
Holding back and lowering by reduction supplies a nonviolent counter-motion to escalation.
Collapse and falling supply the hidden cost of conduct performed without awareness.
Softening hard force anchors de-amplification to the focus ayah's corrective mechanism.

structural_cues: 49:2-3 contrast raising voices with deliberately lowering them and place unnoticed loss between those poles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies amplification, reduction, and unnoticed damage; I infer a conflict ecology in which mediation first lowers dominance signals. A live alternative confines these cues to etiquette toward the messenger.

changed_reading.before: Intervention begins when fighting and overt aggression are already visible.
changed_reading.after: The same corrective arc can begin earlier by lowering signals that amplify rank and hostility before armed coercion is needed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report-to-clarification-to-impact-to-regret chain makes verification an evidentiary gate before the focus ayah's shift from mutual fighting to identifying the one overstepping party.

activation_trace.role: A delivered report supplies the potentially mediated claim that starts the decision chain.
Disclosure by expression or sign makes clarification an active evidentiary operation.
Striking the intended target makes the cost of a false classification concrete.
Agitated lack of restraint supplies the mode in which unverified action outruns judgment.
Regret over what has escaped supplies the irreversible downstream consequence.
Overstepping into oppression is the classification that must be established before selective force.

structural_cues: 49:6 orders clarification between receipt of a report and striking a people; 49:9 likewise differentiates one aggressing side before directing force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a causal warning about report, clarification, impact, and regret; I infer that identifying the aggressor requires verified evidence. A live alternative treats 49:6 only as a separate rule for news.

changed_reading.before: Once one faction is alleged to have transgressed, selective force may follow.
changed_reading.after: The move from reciprocal fighting to a named aggressor is an adjudicative finding gated by clarification, not a label inherited from the loudest report.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between imposed hardship and faith made beloved and adorned in hearts gives return two coexisting horizons: externally, aggression stops at a legal threshold; internally, durable reintegration moves toward willing, rightly directed attachment that force cannot manufacture.

activation_trace.role: Severe hardship marks the failure mode of merely following collective pressure.
Clinging love supplies an inward motive different from compelled compliance.
Making something appear good supplies the heartward formation of willing alignment.
Hitting the right face of an affair supplies practical maturity as the desired durable state.
Turning back anchors the internal trajectory to the focus ayah's explicit external endpoint.

structural_cues: 49:7 contrasts painful compliance with God making faith beloved and rebellion hateful before 49:9 demands return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external obedience and internal affection; I infer that durable return has an inward horizon beyond cessation. A live alternative keeps 49:9's return wholly juridical and reads 49:7 as a separate account of guidance.

changed_reading.before: Return means that the aggressor ceases and submits outwardly.
changed_reading.after: Outward cessation remains the enforceable threshold, while a distinct, non-coercible process must turn compliance into willing reintegration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah redescribes believers as siblings and the two parties as two brothers; the tether and kinship branches make intervention emergency care within one relation, with mercy preserving the bond after force ends.

activation_trace.role: Sibling kinship turns apparently opposed camps into members of one family relation.
A tether supplies the image of a bond that restrains separation without erasing either side.
Kinship supplies mercy as preservation of a shared relation, not softness toward ongoing harm.
The tie between parties is the focus anchor that kinship intensifies.
Removing mutual aversion gives kin preservation its concrete repair action.

structural_cues: 49:10 immediately compresses the two factions into the dual expression 'your two brothers' and repeats reconciliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sibling language, tether, kinship, and repeated repair; I infer that selective force protects an internal bond rather than expelling an alien enemy. A live alternative treats brotherhood as moral framing without changing procedure.

changed_reading.before: The settlement resembles a treaty between two opposed groups.
changed_reading.after: It is repair of a tethered kin relation: coercion protects one part from another, and mercy governs their continued life after restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pushing by insult, settled suspicion, covert tracking, and speech in absence form a previolent injury chain; the focus branch of a wound spreading into corruption lets baghy include an expanding relational lesion that can precede open fighting.

activation_trace.role: A push delivered through faulting supplies symbolic aggression as a social shove.
Bad suspicion of people supplies the interpretive atmosphere in which injury compounds.
Secretly tracking reports supplies a covert channel that feeds factional accusation.
Mentioning someone in absence supplies reputational damage that circulates without encounter.
A wound spreading into corruption anchors these symbolic acts as an exploratory prehistory of overt overstepping.

structural_cues: 49:11's branchless roots ن ب ز and ل ق ب are used only as structural cues: hostile nicknaming sits beside faulting, then 49:12 proceeds through suspicion, spying, and backbiting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of symbolic harms and a focus wound image; I supply the arrow from repeated micro-injury to open baghy. A live alternative treats the listed harms as parallel prohibitions rather than a causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: Baghy begins when one faction commits an overt act of oppression.
changed_reading.after: Baghy can be approached as a wound that spreads through labels, suspicion, surveillance, and absent speech before it erupts as reciprocal combat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet places branching apart and joining a fissure under one root, then adds groups facing one another for recognition; this changes reconciliation from homogenization into a reversible joining of differentiated social branches.

activation_trace.role: Branching and dispersal supply the real differentiation from which groups arise.
Joining a fissure supplies the reverse operation by which separation can be repaired.
Groups turning toward one another supply a face-to-face social geometry instead of absorption.
Recognition through distinguishing marks makes preserved difference the means of relation.
Bounded portions anchor the branching model in the focus ayah's two factions.

structural_cues: 49:13 says peoples and tribes are made for mutual recognition after 49:9-10 repair two bounded believer groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiation, fissure-joining, mutual facing, and recognition; I infer that successful repair preserves legitimate plurality. A live alternative reads 49:13 as universal anthropology unrelated to conflict design.

changed_reading.before: Reconciliation succeeds by dissolving factional difference into unity.
changed_reading.after: Reconciliation rejoins a fissure while retaining bounded branches, redirecting difference into face-to-face recognition rather than forced sameness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later distinction between saying belief, belief entering hearts, and truth realized in action makes 'from the believers' a binding communal designation but not proof that every party's inner trust is settled; believer identity therefore intensifies responsibility without immunizing conduct from a baghy finding.

activation_trace.role: Settled security supplies the inward condition that the later speech says has not yet occurred.
Entry into an interior supplies the difference between an asserted label and inward arrival.
The heart supplies the interior site whose state cannot be inferred merely from group speech.
Fulfilling claim through action supplies conduct as the test of asserted identity.
The shared believer designation remains the focus ayah's communal anchor despite internal incompleteness.
Observable overstepping remains actionable even inside the named believer community.

structural_cues: 49:14 contrasts spoken belief with belief not yet entering hearts; 49:15 then ties truthfulness to enacted commitment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gap between social claim, inner entry, and enacted truth; I infer that 49:9's believer label creates solidarity, not moral immunity. A live alternative limits the distinction to the particular speakers in 49:14.

changed_reading.before: Calling both factions believers certifies their settled inner faith and makes aggression anomalous.
changed_reading.after: The designation preserves rights and kinship while leaving conduct fully adjudicable; claimed membership neither reveals the heart nor cancels responsibility for overstepping.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated rejection of burdening others by recounting a favor, followed by gentle guidance, changes post-return politics: interveners must not convert successful restraint into a permanent debt that humiliates the restored party.

activation_trace.role: Weighing down a recipient by rehearsing a favor supplies the danger of turning aid into durable domination.
Release without compensation supplies the contrary model for ending the intervener's claim.
Gentle indication toward the path supplies reintegration without humiliating ownership.
Return anchors the non-indebted reintegration model in the focus sequence.

structural_cues: 49:17 reverses the direction of claimed favor: people may not burden the messenger with their submission; guidance is attributed to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favor-as-burden, release, and gentle guidance; I infer that restoration should not leave the returned faction under the victor's moral lien. A live alternative confines the warning to boasting about conversion.

changed_reading.before: The restrained faction returns owing enduring gratitude and lowered status to those who compelled it.
changed_reading.after: Return ends both force and the intervener's ownership claim; reintegration should not be converted into a rehearsed favor or permanent moral debt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing allocation of unseen knowledge to God while making deeds visible to divine sight sharpens a human limit: conflict intervention may classify verified conduct as overstepping, but it may not convert that finding into possession of inner motives or final faith-status.

activation_trace.role: Full disclosure to the knower reserves comprehensive knowledge beyond the human tribunal.
What is screened from eyes supplies the inaccessible interior domain.
Seeing with the eye foregrounds manifest evidence and observable action.
Intended action supplies the conduct that is actually available for accountability.
Overstepping into oppression remains a conduct finding while motives remain epistemically contained.

structural_cues: 49:18 closes the surah by pairing God's knowledge of the unseen with sight of what people do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine access to unseen reality and visible deeds; I infer a human asymmetry between judging conduct and claiming hearts. A live alternative reads the close only as assurance of divine accountability.

changed_reading.before: Naming the aggressor also morally ranks the parties' inward faith and intentions.
changed_reading.after: Intervention acts firmly on verified overstepping while refusing to pretend that observable conduct grants exhaustive knowledge of either party's heart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping of the hand cue into strength; it remains anchored by the focus sequence of corrective force returning to God's command and by 49:1's prohibition on precedence. Render it as a suggestive constraint on power, not as a lexical gloss of the hand phrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Corrective fighting is ordered only until return to God's command.

activation_trace.role: Advancing ahead supplies the prohibited directional motion.
The non-dominant strength branch turns the hand cue into an exploratory image of power that must not move first.
Subduing force supplies the power whose timing is constrained.
The binding command supplies the authority that corrective power must trail.

changed_reading.before: Power is legitimate whenever it aims at the right outcome.
changed_reading.after: Even corrective power becomes baghy-like if it outruns the command it claims to serve: strength must trail authority.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the name cue in 49:11 splits into a non-dominant poison family; it remains useful because that same mapped inventory contains both penetration by poison and repair inserted between disparate sides, directly reactivating the focus interval and reconciliation. Render as a controlled material analogy, never as the meaning of 'name'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled command to repair the interval between the two factions.

activation_trace.role: Poison entering the body supplies an exploratory image for a hostile designation penetrating the communal relation.
Repair entering between disparate things supplies the exact counter-motion of mediation into the damaged gap.
The interval between the factions anchors where poison and counter-repair operate.
Reconciliation anchors the counter-insertion as social repair rather than free imagery.

changed_reading.before: Hostile labels are peripheral speech offenses adjacent to the conflict rule.
changed_reading.after: A hostile designation can be carried as poison injected into the relational interval, while reconciliation is a deliberate counter-substance inserted into that same gap.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This carries a deliberate split-root contrast: the dominant guidance inventory supplies gentle direction, while the non-dominant mapped inventory supplies severe breaking. It remains anchored to force-until-return, but downstream prose must present destruction as the feared excess against which guidance is contrasted, not as a sense of guidance itself.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Fight only until the aggressing side turns back, then immediately resume reconciliation.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a path supplies a non-destructive route of return.
The non-dominant severe-breaking branch supplies the exploratory failure pole of unbounded coercion.
Subduing until force softens anchors coercion as correction rather than demolition.
Return provides the stopping threshold that prevents corrective force from crossing into destruction.

changed_reading.before: Any degree of force is acceptable if it eventually induces return.
changed_reading.after: Return must remain reachable: corrective pressure is bounded against destructive breaking and should leave open a gentler path back.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The body model is cross-domain and therefore surprising, but it remains anchored by two believer portions in mutual combat and by the later self, flesh, and kinship branches. Render it as a social-body analogy that explains preservation plus restraint, not as a claim that the focus ayah literally depicts anatomy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Two portions of one believer community fight, yet both remain objects of reconciliation.

activation_trace.role: Bounded portions supply distinct parts that can still belong to a larger whole.
Mutual combat supplies the self-damaging interaction between those parts.
The thing's own self or identity turns harm to another member into harm within one social self.
Kinship as connective flesh supplies the tissue joining parties who appear separate.
Consumption as corrosion supplies the mechanism by which one part degrades the shared body.

changed_reading.before: The community restrains an enemy faction and later readmits it.
changed_reading.after: The community interrupts an autoimmune episode: one bounded part is stopped from consuming another so their connective tissue and shared life can be repaired.

strongest_changes: Selective force is evidentially gated, derivative, and terminated by return rather than victory.
The second reconciliation is a distributive rebalancing of burdens and shares, not mere cessation.
Brotherhood and the relational middle make the conflict internal repair among tethered parts.
Later speech harms activate baghy as a spreading wound with a previolent social history.
Plurality, inward reintegration, and conduct-based accountability remain distinct coexisting readings rather than one merged explanation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sequence supported a strong legal-restorative baseline, while context activated less conservative models of de-amplification, evidentiary restraint, kin preservation, symbolic wound propagation, differentiated plurality, non-humiliating return, and limits on judging hearts. Split mappings added contained material contrasts of power, poison, repair, guidance, and destruction without replacing the ordinary roots.
remaining_uncertainties: The subduing branch of ق ت ل sharpens the function of combat but does not remove the live literal killing branch.
The inward-return model may be a contextual horizon rather than part of the enforceable threshold in 49:9.
The causal path from symbolic injury to armed conflict is abductive; the same context can remain a set of parallel prohibitions.
Non-dominant split-root outliers are deliberately exploratory and should never be rendered as lexical substitutions.
